facts.claim: Apache Lucene’s documentation: its terms index is an inverted index, because it can list, for a term, the documents that contain it.
Robertson and Zaragoza (2009) call BM25 one of the most successful text-retrieval algorithms to come out of the probabilistic relevance framework.
BEIR (Thakur et al., 2021) tested ten retrieval systems on 18 public datasets and found BM25 a robust baseline on data the systems were not trained for.
scikit-learn’s guide: precision is the share of what was picked that is right; recall is the share of the right ones that were found.
